summary: Round-6 (5 new features) tested end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_round6_features.py (15 tests, 15/15 passing) covering Version Lock (list version present, stale=409 with 'modified' message, correct version increments +1), Login Tagline (PUT /api/site-config/ persists, GET /api/branding/ exposes public login_tagline, non-admin PUT blocked 403), Timeline Export (/api/print/timeline/?household_id&token 200 HTML), Completeness Chart (dashboard completeness_bands with ready/in_progress/needs_attention, band filter ?band=in_progress 200), Services (future date 400, today 201, bulk_log 201, stats 200, monthly_detail with missed[], all 3 print/service-report variants 200), RBAC (caseworker POSTing service to unassigned household blocked 400/403). Frontend: Playwright verified data-testid presence and interactions for all 5 features: login-tagline shows 'TEST tagline round6', completeness-chart + completeness-band-in_progress + staff-ranking + org-progress-bar + missed-households-card render on admin dashboard, band click navigates and filters households, /services page loads with 'Log selected' + 'Mark all served today' buttons, export-timeline-button on /households/60, services-panel + add-service-button render, org-tagline-input present in /settings/organisation. 14/14 UI checks passed.

minor.issue: List serializer returns 'assigned_to_ids' but not 'version' field. Detail endpoint returns 'version'. Not a bug — FE fetches full detail before edit — but is worth noting for consistency.

critical_code_review_comments: core/views.py already flagged >680 lines in iter5; adding ServiceDeliveryViewSet (bulk_log/stats/monthly_detail actions), SiteConfigView and dashboard completeness_bands has likely pushed it well past the 700-line split threshold. Recommend extracting Services/SiteConfig/Branding/Dashboard into separate modules.

HouseholdViewSet.perform_update increments version but if two concurrent PATCHes both pass the same current version they could race (same as the AssessmentViewSet race noted in iter5). A DB-level unique-together / select_for_update inside a transaction is the definitive fix. 409 handling only guards clients that submitted the stale version — it doesn't prevent concurrent writers who both read version=N.

ServiceDelivery.beneficiary via GenericForeignKey — ensure DELETE cascade or SET_NULL is handled when Caregiver/HouseholdMember is deleted; otherwise dangling FK by content_type+object_id. Consider a signal or overriding delete().
Print tokens continue to travel in ?token= query params — persistent smell from previous rounds; logged in web-server access logs.

Household list serializer uses 'assigned_to_ids' while detail uses 'assigned_to' with nested names — a minor inconsistency; unify field naming to avoid FE confusion (a real trap that caused a false positive in test iteration authoring).
